exact_statement: For any index type iota and f : Nat x iota -> Complex, if f(0,gamma)=0 for every gamma and the actual shifted pair-index norm series norm(f(n+1,gamma)) is summable, then the original norm series is summable, f is summable, and its actual unconditional tsum equals the shifted pair-index tsum.
construction: The literal successor map (n,gamma) -> (n+1,gamma) is proved injective. Outside its range, the natural coordinate must be zero, so both the original values and norms vanish. The pinned injective summability and HasSum transfer theorems then apply.
semantic_checks: The whole zero slice is explicitly zero; it may be infinite, and is not treated as a single removable term.
The only convergence hypothesis is actual shifted absolute summability; no equality or full-series summability is assumed.
Both sums use unconditional summation over the same actual product index type. No unproved interchange of iterated sums occurs.
The type iota can be Fin d -> Nat with d=0 included, or any other type, without a countability assumption.
